DESIGN-BRIEF.md:
Disposable responsive web calculator; visual planning/prototype only, no production implementation or source import. User selected tactile porcelain/cobalt via actual ask_user (plan ca1c0001 D-05). Build one compact calculator surface, not a landing page/dashboard. Preserve minimal arithmetic, readable results, keyboard/focus and desktop/mobile scope. No history, settings, scientific mode, account, persistence or analytics.
Design proposal within selected direction: porcelain #F4F7FB, white key surface #FFFFFF, ink #152238, cobalt #214ACD, secondary/boundary #56657A, focus amber #945100. Shallow raised rectangular keys, a cobalt operator rail as the characteristic element, otherwise restrained; no gradients/decorative card stacks. Control font Trebuchet MS/Tahoma/Arial/sans-serif; arithmetic/result Consolas/Liberation Mono/monospace with tabular digits. Existing system fonts only, no downloads. Title 20px, controls 18–20px, expression 18px, result 40px mobile/56px desktop, fit long values without clipping.
Wireframes: desktop [left-aligned expression/result/status | four-column keypad/operator rail], approximately 720px max instrument width at 1280x800. Mobile [title][expression/result][status/error][Clear/Backspace][four-column keypad], 390x844 and fit 320px without page overflow. Keys: row 7 8 9 ÷; row 4 5 6 ×; row 1 2 3 −; row 0 . = +. Utility row Clear, Backspace.
Real copy: Calculator, Clear, Backspace; digits 0–9, decimal, ÷ × − + =. Accessible names Divide/Multiply/Subtract/Add/Equals. Initial 0; examples 2 + 3 = 5 and 1.5 + 2.25 = 3.75. Error: Cannot divide by zero. Clear to start again. Basic pocket-calculator behavior, not a scientific parser. States in both viewports: initial, entry, computed/decimal result, operator-selected, divide-by-zero, Clear recovery, visible keyboard focus, long result. Flows: calculate including decimal; error then recovery.
Semantic named buttons/result output with appropriate polite announcement; natural tab order, 44px minimum targets, 2px visible offset focus outline; digits/operators/decimal, Enter or =, Backspace, Escape. Selected operator needs non-color indicator; error includes text. Honor reduced motion, no unsolicited animation. Proposed text pairs numerically exceed 4.5:1; inspect actual rendered accessibility, don't claim certification.
No production calculator components/tokens exist: component map is empty; no repository calculator files authorized. A minimal local test fixture was inspected as evidence only; do not transfer/copy its source, expression splitting, automatic clicks or localStorage proof. New display/keypad/feedback/tokens belong only to your isolated prototype workspace; describe actual generated paths when available, never pretend they are production paths. No images, URLs, captures or third-party reference/brand/assets supplied. Send no unrelated/private source or credentials. Deliver real Preview/Studio, target-aware v2 handoff JSON and readable Markdown with DES criteria for all named screens/flows/states/viewports. Human approval and same-plan reconciliation are later explicit steps; never self-approve or execute product code.
